package core

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Xustalis/OpenPanda/internal/intake"
)

// Characterization of the fixed baseline, not an invariant for future releases.
func TestSuperAgentBaselineDeliveryVersusFact(t *testing.T) {
	c := newIntakeCore(t)
	body := []byte(`{"action":"created","repository":{"id":100,"full_name":"example/widgets"},"issue":{"number":9,"title":"sample"},"comment":{"id":300,"body":"@panda please summarize"},"sender":{"id":400,"login":"example-user"}}`)
	ev, ok, err := intake.ParseGitHub("issue_comment", body)
	if !ok || err != nil {
		t.Fatal(ok, err)
	}
	for _, delivery := range []string{"fixture-1", "fixture-1", "fixture-2"} {
		ev.Delivery = delivery
		if _, err := c.IntakeTask(context.Background(), ev, "", PriorityNormal); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	requireRowCount(t, c, "tasks", 2)
	requireRowCount(t, c, "execution_requests", 2)
	t.Log("one created comment, three admissions with two distinct delivery IDs: two queued tasks; no worker started")
}
